candidates.text: swapAndBridgeWithETH and swapAndBridgeWithERC20 must remain usable (not revert) regardless of whether the Slipstream SwapRouter holds any ETH.
evidence_ids: Full DoS of swap-and-bridge. Both `swapAndBridgeWithETH` and `swapAndBridgeWithERC20` are unusable whenever the Slipstream SwapRouter holds any ETH. Users cannot swap and bridge from Base to the destination chain via the protocol.

So the Slipstream router sends its full ETH balance to `msg.sender`, which is `TrustSwapAndBridgeRouter`. `TrustSwapAndBridgeRouter` has no `receive()` or `fallback()` and does not handle incoming ETH. A plain ETH transfer to it reverts. Therefore, if the Slipstream SwapRouter has any ETH balance at the time of the call, the entire `swapAndBridgeWithETH` or `swapAndBridgeWithERC20` transaction reverts.
